title: FIFO ASCII read
text: Read simple data streams, 3 inputs, 2 outputs, {Output vector type} sets output data type 8 bit uint null; {Maximum read size} sets the maximum number of characters returned, {Minimum read size} sets the minimum number of characters returned, {Read to delimiter} sets the return delimited element sets, {Delimiter} sets the terminator value for delimited element, {Max and Min read size ports} enables maximum and minimum input ports, {Enable passthrough} and {Sample time}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: F
ports.summary: FIFO from which to read data serialfifoptr

ports.name: MAX
ports.summary: Maximum number of bytes to read from FIFO integer

ports.name: MIN
ports.summary: Minimum number of bytes to read from FIFO integer

ports.name: D
ports.summary: Parsed data read from FIFO vector

ports.name: ENA
ports.summary: Pass value of MAX through integer

params.name: Maximum read size
params.values: Maximum number of characters returned by block 1024 (default) | integer

params.name: Minimum read size
params.values: Minimum number of characters returned by block 1 (default) | integer

params.name: Read to delimiter
params.values: Return delimited element sets on (default) | off

params.name: Delimiter
params.values: Terminator value for delimited element sets 13 (default) | uint

params.name: Output vector type
params.values: Specify output data type 8 bit uint null terminated (default) | count+32 bit int | count+32 bit uint | count+16 bit int | count+16 bit uint | 8 bit int null terminated

params.name: Max and Min read size ports
params.values: Enable maximum and minimum input ports off (default) | on

params.name: Enable passthrough
params.values: Enable passthrough of MAX value off (default) | on
